scope: Development-only feasibility probe; no final validation, attack evaluation, certificate issuance or production policy changes
time_reference: ROS bag record time, integer nanoseconds; offline availability proxy, not authenticated live clock
selection: One radar chunk containing each target fraction of indexed route duration; no speed-based reselection
imu_selection: Every IMU chunk whose indexed times overlap selected radar chunk, with 250 ms preceding margin
predictor: Nonnegative clipped affine least-squares conversion of trailing 1000 ms median absolute raw radar speed; one fit only, no search
obd_conversion: kph / 3.6; assumed benign offline fitting/comparison label only, never witness predictor input
targets_interpretation: Engineering feasibility targets, not paper-derived accuracy claims, formal bounds, or independent test guarantees
clock_invalid: Exclude nonfinite speed, future header stamp or header older than max delivery; do not interpolate future samples
limitations: OBD label is not independent ground truth
All windows are from one development drive
Recorded availability is not live causal latency verification
Postprocessed reference not used as witness
